description: A React component for managing email event notification settings, including fetching, updating, resetting, and displaying user-configurable email notification preferences.

methods.name: EmailEventSettings
methods.description: A React functional component that displays and manages email notification event settings.

methods.name: fetchEventSettings
methods.description: Fetches current email event settings from backend API.

methods.name: handleCheckboxChange
methods.description: Handles change in checkbox states for each email event.

methods.name: handleSaveSettings
methods.description: Saves the current email event settings to the backend.

methods.name: handleResetSettings
methods.description: Resets email event settings to default via backend API.

methods.name: getEventDescription
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string for each email event type.
